title: スプリンターズSの後に・『速さ』

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Following a breathtaking, electrifying race, Taiki Shuttle conquers the Sprinters Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her thrilling performance leaves the spectators positively spellbound.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But her legs aren't ready to slow down just yet. She's on to the race to crown the autumn King of the Mile—the Mile Championship!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taiki Shuttle faces two major challenges—to conquer both the spring and autumn G1 mile races, and to win the autumn G1 sprint!
